summary.en: There is no acute crisis in Moldova. The EU accession process, integration into the European energy grid and cultural achievements are moving in a positive direction; education and human rights problems in Transnistria, detentions of Ukrainian border guards, a possible IMF programme, concerns over gas supply, and an investigation into alleged Russian data collection, however, are creating tension. Although the tone of the news is more negative than average, events are at the level of an ordinary period; the score is slightly below 50.

en: Violations of the right to education and pressure on students in Transnistria (Promo-LEX report)
Repeated detention of Ukrainian border guards on the Moldovan side
The Prime Minister not ruling out a possible IMF programme, and concerns over gas supply
Integration into the European energy system via the Isaccea-Vulcănești-Chișinău line and EU accession negotiations
Investigation into a possible Russian data collection operation

summary.en: The period mixes routine positives (new Romanian government pledging support, a new airline route, a Prut bridge nearing completion, a parcel-locker expansion) with tensions: a border incident involving Ukrainian guards, a Transnistria metallurgical plant being blocked, and reports of household heating hardship. Overall this reads as an ordinary day with some friction, so the score sits slightly below neutral.

en: Border incident involving Ukrainian guards and the Transnistria dispute
Blocking of the Rybnitsa metallurgical plant's trade
New Romanian government pledging investment and support for Moldova

summary.en: The period is mostly routine government business, with the most notable items being new Romania-Moldova diplomatic engagement (the incoming Romanian PM's first foreign visit to Chișinău) and tourism and convergence-fund planning. Security concerns from withdrawing border guards from four Ukraine-side crossings and Transnistria reform debates keep the score only slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Romanian PM's first foreign visit set for Chișinău
Withdrawal of border staff from four Ukraine crossings amid Russian attacks
Five-year collective bargaining plan and convergence fund details

summary.en: The day mixed routine governance and foreign aid (a US cybersecurity grant, EU farm and irrigation support, energy interconnection and heating upgrades) with sharp security tension over Transnistria, including Russian warnings of possible military confrontation and reports of a GRU influence centre. No actual violence is reported, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Russian warnings of possible military confrontation over Transnistria
US $1.2M cybersecurity grant and EU farm and irrigation support
Reports of a GRU psychological operations centre in Tiraspol

summary.en: A Russian Geran-type drone crashed near a house in Telenești, prompting Chișinău to move to expel a Russian diplomat, and mass protests in Tiraspol against Chișinău's fiscal and economic pressure drew attention. Tensions are elevated and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but there is no sign of violence on Moldovan soil or a harsh crackdown, and some positive items (EU-backed hospital energy upgrades) offset the strain.

en: Russian drone crash near a home; diplomatic expulsion response
Mass Tiraspol protest against Chișinău's economic pressure
EU-funded hospital energy renovation projects announced

summary.en: A Russian Geran-4 drone with an explosive payload fell near homes in Telenești, and Chișinău expelled a Russian diplomat in response, with Moscow promising a firm reply. Partly offset by a €150 million EIB agriculture financing deal and reports of a foiled destabilisation attempt, the day was tense but without casualties or a broader crisis.

en: Russian drone fell near homes in Telenești; no casualties reported
Moldova expelled a Russian embassy employee; Moscow promised a firm response
EIB granted €150 million to modernise Moldovan agriculture

summary.en: The period mixes positive diplomatic and economic news, including a drone-production deal with Ukraine, EU accession talks and grant programmes, with security tensions from Russia's threat of a 'harsh response' over an expelled diplomat and Transnistria militarisation claims. Overall the picture is a slightly-above-routine day with elevated but not crisis-level tension.

en: Moldova-Ukraine agreement on joint drone and military technology production
Russia threatens a 'harsh response' over diplomat expulsion
Transnistria tensions and militarisation accusations

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine but constructive diplomacy: Romania's prime minister's first foreign visit to Chișinău, a Moldova–Ukraine military cooperation deal, and renewed Cypriot backing for EU accession. Negatives are minor (a fatal road accident, concerns about Russian control of Yandex Go, a less ambitious EU roadmap), and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Romanian PM's first foreign visit to Chișinău, with high-level meetings
Moldova–Ukraine military cooperation agreement on anti-drone and air defence
Cyprus reaffirms support for Moldova's EU accession

summary.en: The period was dominated by a Romanian PM's first visit to Chișinău, with new energy cooperation (Black Sea gas from 2027), trade growth to €4.5bn, and progress on the Vulcănești–Chișinău power line. These gains are partly offset by a major cyberattack exposing personal data of about 750,000 citizens and a sharp rise in gas bills.

en: Romania-Moldova cooperation: Black Sea gas purchases agreed from 2027
Romanian PM visit reaffirms EU accession support and trade growth to €4.5bn
Cyberattack on government systems exposing data of ~750,000 citizens

summary.en: The period mixes a serious cyberattack that exposed data of 750,000 citizens, a ministerial resignation and a controversial defence deal with Ukraine, against routine economic and infrastructure news and some EU-backed investment. Institutions are responding through the National Security Council and no violence or unrest is reported, so the score sits somewhat below an ordinary day.

en: Cyberattack compromising data of 750,000 citizens; Security Council convened
Hungary blocking EU accession negotiations for Moldova and Ukraine
Opposition criticism of the military agreement with Ukraine

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: government investment announcements, budget allocations for salaries, a new foreign-integration law and financial-sector cooperation. It is offset by a cyber incident exposing data of about 750,000 citizens, which triggered a parliamentary inquiry and a Security Council meeting, plus heightened tensions with Tiraspol and Russia.

en: Cyber incident compromised data of about 750,000 citizens; parliamentary inquiry launched
Government announced 19 strategic projects and 900+ EU-funded construction sites
Parliament adopted foreign integration law; BNM and EMF cooperation memorandum signed

summary.en: A mostly routine day with several modest positives: pension funding released, hospital financing confirmed, and gas bought below European prices. Offsetting concerns include low Dniester water reserves, Transnistria information-control disputes, and more negative-than-average news tone.

en: Pension and benefit payments funded for November
Regional hospital financing and timelines confirmed in Bălți and Cahul
Gas purchased below European prices; Dniester water reserves remain low

summary.en: Moldova saw repeated drone incursions that forced temporary airspace closures in the north and centre, tied to Russian attacks on Ukraine, plus Transnistria tensions over Russian troops. Local elections and a referendum were held in seven localities, a routine democratic process, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Repeated drone incursions and temporary airspace closures in northern and central Moldova
Transnistria dispute: demand for withdrawal of Russian troops
Local elections and referendum held in seven localities

summary.en: Moldova's last 24 hours mixed routine governance with security pressure: local elections and a referendum concluded, and a joint Romania-Moldova defence procurement under SAFE was announced, alongside praise in the EU enlargement assessment. Drone incursions, a cyberattack on the banking sector, Russian sabotage recruitment, and a row over Ukrainian grain at Giurgiulești weigh against this, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Joint Romania-Moldova military procurement under SAFE programme announced
Drone airspace violations and Russian-linked sabotage recruitment reports
Cyberattack disinformation on banking sector; central bank response

summary.en: The period mixes security concerns, including 19 drone airspace violations in October with six drones exploding on Moldovan soil and tensions over Transnistria and the Giurgiulești port incident. Against this, Moldova gained new defence and strategic partnerships with Romania and the UK, and reported its heating-season gas is fully contracted, so the overall picture is mildly positive rather than a crisis.
summary.it: Il periodo combina preoccupazioni di sicurezza, tra cui 19 violazioni dello spazio aereo da parte di droni in ottobre, con sei droni esplosi sul suolo moldavo, e tensioni legate alla Transnistria e all'incidente nel porto di Giurgiulești. In questo quadro, la Moldova ha ottenuto nuove partnership strategiche e nel settore della difesa con Romania e Regno Unito, e ha riferito che il gas per la stagione di riscaldamento è interamente contrattato; il quadro complessivo è quindi moderatamente positivo piuttosto che di crisi.
summary.ru: Период сочетает проблемы безопасности, включая 19 нарушений воздушного пространства дронами в октябре, при этом шесть дронов взорвались на молдавской территории, а также напряженность вокруг Приднестровья и инцидент в порту Гюргюлешть. На этом фоне Молдова получила новые оборонные и стратегические партнерства с Румынией и Великобританией и сообщила, что газ для отопительного сезона полностью законтрактован, поэтому общая картина скорее умеренно позитивная, а не кризисная.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين المخاوف الأمنية، ومنها 19 انتهاكاً للمجال الجوي بطائرات مسيّرة في أكتوبر، وانفجار ست طائرات مسيّرة على الأراضي المولدوفية، إلى جانب التوترات المتعلقة بترانسنيستريا وحادثة ميناء جورجيوليشتي. وفي المقابل، حصلت مولدوفا على شراكات دفاعية واستراتيجية جديدة مع رومانيا والمملكة المتحدة، وأفادت بأن الغاز المخصص لموسم التدفئة قد جرى التعاقد عليه بالكامل، ومن ثم فإن الصورة العامة إيجابية بشكل معتدل وليست أزمة.
summary.fa: این دوره نگرانی‌های امنیتی را با هم دارد، از جمله 19 نقض حریم هوایی توسط پهپاد در ماه اکتبر که شش پهپاد در خاک مولداوی منفجر شدند، و تنش‌ها بر سر ترانس‌نیستریا و حادثه بندر گیورگیولشتی. در مقابل، مولداوی شراکت‌های دفاعی و راهبردی جدیدی با رومانی و بریتانیا به دست آورد و اعلام کرد گاز فصل گرمایش به طور کامل قرارداد شده است، بنابراین تصویر کلی اندکی مثبت است و نه بحران.
summary.zh: 该时期兼有安全问题：10月份发生19起无人机侵入领空事件，其中6架无人机在摩尔多瓦境内爆炸，同时涉及德涅斯特河沿岸地区的紧张局势以及久尔久勒什蒂港事件。与此同时，摩尔多瓦与罗马尼亚和英国达成了新的国防与战略合作伙伴关系，并报告称供暖季的天然气已全部签约，因此总体形势略为积极，并非危机。
summary.tr: Bu dönemde güvenlik kaygıları öne çıkıyor: Ekim ayında 19 insansız hava aracı hava sahası ihlali yaşandı, altı drone Moldova topraklarında patladı; Dinyester ve Giurgiulești limanındaki olayla ilgili gerginlikler sürdü. Buna karşılık Moldova, Romanya ve Birleşik Krallık ile yeni savunma ve stratejik ortaklıklar kazandı ve ısınma sezonu için doğal gazının tamamen sözleşmeye bağlandığını bildirdi; bu nedenle genel tablo bir kriz değil, hafif olumlu.
summary.es: El periodo combina problemas de seguridad, incluidas 19 violaciones del espacio aéreo por drones en octubre, con seis drones que explotaron en suelo moldavo, y tensiones en torno a Transnistria y al incidente del puerto de Giurgiulești. Frente a ello, Moldavia obtuvo nuevas asociaciones de defensa y estratégicas con Rumanía y el Reino Unido, e informó de que el gas para la temporada de calefacción está totalmente contratado, por lo que el panorama general es levemente positivo y no una crisis.
summary.fr: La période combine des préoccupations de sécurité, dont 19 violations de l'espace aérien par des drones en octobre, six drones ayant explosé sur le sol moldave, et des tensions autour de la Transnistrie et de l'incident du port de Giurgiulești. En revanche, la Moldavie a conclu de nouveaux partenariats de défense et stratégiques avec la Roumanie et le Royaume-Uni, et a indiqué que son gaz pour la saison de chauffage est entièrement contracté ; le tableau d'ensemble est donc légèrement positif plutôt qu'une crise.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum ist von Sicherheitsbedenken geprägt, darunter 19 Drohnenverletzungen des Luftraums im Oktober, wobei sechs Drohnen auf moldauischem Boden explodierten, sowie Spannungen um Transnistrien und den Zwischenfall im Hafen Giurgiulești. Demgegenüber gewann Moldau neue Verteidigungs- und strategische Partnerschaften mit Rumänien und dem Vereinigten Königreich und meldete, dass das Gas für die Heizperiode vollständig vertraglich gebunden ist; das Gesamtbild ist daher leicht positiv und keine Krise.
summary.pt: O período combina preocupações de segurança, incluindo 19 violações do espaço aéreo por drones em outubro, com seis drones explodindo em solo moldavo, e tensões em torno da Transnístria e do incidente no porto de Giurgiulești. Em contrapartida, a Moldávia obteve novas parcerias de defesa e estratégicas com a Roménia e o Reino Unido, e informou que o gás para a época de aquecimento está totalmente contratado; por isso, o quadro geral é levemente positivo e não uma crise.
summary.ja: この期間には安全保障上の懸念が混在しており、10月にはドローンによる領空侵犯が19件発生し、そのうち6機がモルドバ領内で爆発した。また、トランスニストリアをめぐる緊張やギュルジュレシュティ港での事案もあった。一方でモルドバは、ルーマニアおよび英国と新たな防衛・戦略的パートナーシップを獲得し、暖房期のガス供給は全量契約済みであると発表した。全体として、危機というより穏やかに前向きな状況である。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 안보 우려가 뒤섞여 있었다. 10월에는 드론의 영공 침범이 19건 발생했고, 그중 6기가 몰도바 영토에서 폭발했다. 또한 트란스니스트리아를 둘러싼 긴장과 기우르주레슈티 항구 사건도 있었다. 반면 몰도바는 루마니아 및 영국과 새로운 국방·전략적 파트너십을 확보했으며, 난방 시즌 가스 물량이 전량 계약되었다고 발표했다. 따라서 전체적으로는 위기라기보다 다소 긍정적인 상황이다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में सुरक्षा संबंधी चिंताएँ और सकारात्मक घटनाक्रम दोनों शामिल हैं। अक्टूबर में ड्रोन द्वारा हवाई क्षेत्र के उल्लंघन की 19 घटनाएँ दर्ज हुईं, जिनमें से छह ड्रोन मोल्डोवा की धरती पर फटे। इसके साथ ही ट्रांसनिस्ट्रिया को लेकर तनाव और गियुर्गियुलेशटी बंदरगाह की घटना भी सामने आई। दूसरी ओर, मोल्दोवा ने रोमानिया और ब्रिटेन के साथ नई रक्षा और रणनीतिक साझेदारियाँ हासिल कीं, और बताया कि तापन मौसम के लिए उसकी गैस आपूर्ति पूरी तरह अनुबंधित है। कुल मिलाकर तस्वीर संकट के बजाय हल्की सकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει ζητήματα ασφάλειας, με 19 παραβιάσεις του εναέριου χώρου από drones τον Οκτώβριο, εκ των οποίων έξι εξερράγησαν σε moldαβικό έδαφος, καθώς και εντάσεις γύρω από την Υπερδνειστερία και το περιστατικό στο λιμάνι του Γκιουργκιουλέστι. Αντίθετα, η Μολδαβία απέκτησε νέες αμυντικές και στρατηγικές συμφωνίες με τη Ρουμανία και το Ηνωμένο Βασίλειο και ανέφερε ότι το αέριο για την περίοδο θέρμανσης είναι πλήρως συμβασιοποιημένο. Συνολικά, η εικόνα είναι ήπια θετική και όχι κρίσιμη.

summary.ja: 今期は中間選挙の投票日に関する定例報道が大半を占め、投票は予定通り行われ、裁判所や諸機関も通常どおり機能している。最高裁が司法省のカリフォルニア州投票用紙に関する要請を退けた例もそれに当たる。マイナス材料としては、ニューヨーク州でのはしかによる死亡、フロリダ州でのジェット機墜落事故による死者、株式市場のわずかな下落があり、スコアはおおむね中立圏にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 중간선거 투표일에 관한 일상적인 보도가 대부분을 차지하며, 투표는 순조롭게 진행되고 법원과 기관도 정상적으로 기능하고 있다. 예컨대 대법원은 법무부의 캘리포니아주 투표용지 관련 요청을 기각했다. 부정적 신호로는 뉴욕주의 홍역 사망, 플로리다주의 제트기 추락 사고, 소폭의 주식 하락이 있으며, 이로 인해 점수는 중립 근처에 머물러 있다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मध्यावधि चुनाव के मतदान दिवस से जुड़ी नियमित कवरेज हावी है, मतदान सुचारु रूप से चल रहा है और अदालतें व संस्थाएँ सामान्य रूप से काम कर रही हैं, जैसे सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वारा न्याय विभाग के कैलिफ़ोर्निया मतपत्रों संबंधी अनुरोध को अस्वीकार करना। नकारात्मक संकेतों में न्यूयॉर्क में खसरे से एक मौत, फ़्लोरिडा में एक जेट विमान दुर्घटना में मौतें और इक्विटी बाज़ार में मामूली गिरावट शामिल हैं, जो स्कोर को लगभग तटस्थ बनाए रखते हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από τη συνήθη κάλυψη της ημέρας των ενδιάμεσων εκλογών, με τη διεξαγωγή της ψηφοφορίας να προχωρά κανονικά και τα δικαστήρια και τους θεσμούς να λειτουργούν ομαλά, όπως όταν το Ανώτατο Δικαστήριο απέρριψε αίτημα του Υπουργείου Δικαιοσύνης σχετικά με τα ψηφοδέλτια της Καλιφόρνιας. Αρνητικά σήματα αποτελούν ένας θάνατος από ιλαρά στη Νέα Υόρκη, ένα θανατηφόρο δυστύχημα αεροσκάφους στη Φλόριντα και μια μικρή πτώση στις μετοχές, που διατηρούν τη βαθμολογία κοντά στο ουδέτερο.
summary.tr: Dönem, rutin ara seçim günü haberciliğiyle öne çıkıyor; oylama sürüyor, mahkemeler ve kurumlar normal işliyor. Örneğin Yüksek Mahkeme, Adalet Bakanlığı'nın oy pusulalarına ilişkin talebini reddetti. Olumsuz sinyaller arasında New York'ta bir kızamık ölümü, Florida'da ölümcül bir jet uçağı kazası ve hafif bir hisse senedi piyasası düşüşü yer alıyor; bu da puanı nötre yakın tutuyor.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por la cobertura rutinaria del día de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, con la votación en marcha y los tribunales y las instituciones funcionando con normalidad, como el Tribunal Supremo al rechazar una solicitud del Departamento de Justicia sobre las boletas electorales. Las señales negativas incluyen una muerte por sarampión en Nueva York, un accidente mortal de avión a reacción en Florida y una ligera caída de la renta variable, lo que mantiene la puntuación cerca de neutral.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par la couverture habituelle du jour des élections de mi-mandat, le scrutin se déroulant normalement et les tribunaux ainsi que les institutions fonctionnant de façon ordinaire, comme lorsque la Cour suprême a rejeté une demande du ministère de la Justice concernant les bulletins de vote. Les signaux négatifs comprennent un décès dû à la rougeole à New York, un accident mortel d'avion à réaction en Floride et un léger recul des actions, ce qui maintient le score près du neutre.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wird von der routinemäßigen Berichterstattung über den Wahltag der Zwischenwahlen geprägt; die Abstimmung läuft, und Gerichte sowie Institutionen arbeiten normal, etwa als der Oberste Gerichtshof einen Antrag des Justizministeriums zu Stimmzetteln abwies. Negative Signale sind ein Masern-Todesfall in New York, ein tödlicher Flugzeugabsturz eines Strahlflugzeugs in Florida und ein leichter Rückgang der Aktienkurse, wodurch der Wert nahe am neutralen Bereich bleibt.
summary.pt: O período é dominado pela cobertura rotineira do dia das eleições de meio de mandato, com a votação em andamento e os tribunais e instituições funcionando normalmente, como quando a Suprema Corte rejeitou um pedido do Departamento de Justiça sobre cédulas eleitorais. Os sinais negativos incluem uma morte por sarampo em Nova York, um acidente fatal com um jato na Flórida e uma leve queda no mercado de ações, o que mantém a pontuação próxima do neutro.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dalla copertura ordinaria del giorno delle elezioni di metà mandato, con le votazioni che procedono e tribunali e istituzioni che funzionano normalmente, come la Corte Suprema che ha respinto una richiesta del DOJ sulle schede elettorali. I segnali negativi includono un decesso per morbillo a New York, un incidente mortale di un jet in Florida e un lieve calo dei mercati azionari, che mantengono il punteggio vicino al neutro.
summary.ru: В этот период доминирует обычное освещение дня промежуточных выборов: голосование проходит штатно, суды и институты работают в обычном режиме, например, Верховный суд отклонил ходатайство Минюста о бюллетенях. Негативные сигналы включают смерть от кори в Нью-Йорке, смертельную катастрофу реактивного самолёта во Флориде и небольшое снижение фондового рынка, что удерживает показатель близко к нейтральному.
summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة التغطية الروتينية ليوم انتخابات منتصف المدة، إذ تسير عملية التصويت بشكل طبيعي وتعمل المحاكم والمؤسسات كالمعتاد، مثل رفض المحكمة العليا طلب وزارة العدل المتعلق ببطاقات الاقتراع. وتشمل الإشارات السلبية وفاة بسبب الحصبة في نيويورك، وتحطم طائرة نفاثة قاتل في فلوريدا، وانخفاض طفيف في أسواق الأسهم، مما يُبقي المؤشر قريبًا من الحياد.

summary.es: Un ataque mortal contra una iglesia en Karak, con varias personas muertas, dominó la cobertura, y el discurso del trono del Rey respondió con mensajes de unidad y seguridad. El Parlamento se inauguró de forma rutinaria con un nuevo presidente, y el tono de GDELT está ligeramente por encima de la media mundial, por lo que la puntuación neta se sitúa cerca de un día rutinario, lastrado por un grave incidente de seguridad.
summary.fr: Une attaque meurtrière contre une église à Karak, qui a fait plusieurs morts, a dominé la couverture médiatique, et le discours du Trône du Roi a répondu par des messages d'unité et de sécurité. Le Parlement s'est ouvert de manière routinière avec un nouveau président, et le ton GDELT se situe légèrement au-dessus de la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que le score net se rapproche d'une journée ordinaire, alourdi par un grave incident de sécurité.
summary.de: Ein tödlicher Angriff auf eine Kirche in Karak, bei dem mehrere Menschen getötet wurden, dominierte die Berichterstattung, und die Thronrede des Königs setzte auf Botschaften der Einheit und Sicherheit. Das Parlament wurde routinemäßig mit einem neuen Sprecher eröffnet, und der GDELT-Tonwert liegt leicht über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt, sodass der Nettowert nahe an einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt, der durch einen schwerwiegenden Sicherheitsvorfall belastet wird.
summary.pt: Um ataque mortal contra uma igreja em Karak, que matou várias pessoas, dominou a cobertura, e o discurso do trono do Rei respondeu com mensagens de unidade e segurança. O Parlamento foi aberto de forma rotineira com um novo presidente, e o tom do GDELT está ligeiramente acima da média mundial, de modo que a pontuação líquida fica próxima de um dia comum, pesada por um incidente grave de segurança.
summary.it: Un attacco mortale contro una chiesa a Karak, con diverse vittime, ha dominato la copertura, mentre il discorso del Trono del Re ha risposto con messaggi di unità e sicurezza. Il Parlamento si è aperto in modo ordinario con un nuovo presidente, e il tono di GDELT è leggermente superiore alla media mondiale, quindi il punteggio netto si colloca su una giornata di routine appesantita da un grave incidente di sicurezza.
summary.ru: Смертоносная атака на церковь в Караке, в результате которой погибли несколько человек, доминировала в освещении, а тронная речь короля была посвящена единству и безопасности. Парламент открылся в обычном порядке с новым спикером, а тон GDELT незначительно выше среднемирового, поэтому итоговый показатель близок к обычному дню, но снижен из-за серьёзного инцидента в сфере безопасности.

新议长当选；例行的制度性交接

summary.en: The country faces a very large Ebola outbreak (9,415 confirmed cases, over 4,500 deaths, spread to 8 provinces, spillover into neighboring Kenya). In addition, armed violence and displacement in the east (Djugu, Rutshuru), cholera-like diarrhoea deaths in North Kivu, the Kabila-led rebel movement and tensions with the government stand out. Payment problems for response teams, actions halting economic activity and protests further aggravate the situation; small positive developments such as school reopenings cannot offset it.

en: Ebola outbreak: 9,415 cases, ~4,500+ deaths, spread to an 8th province, unvaccinated strain
Armed violence and mass displacement in the east (Djugu 24,600; Rutshuru 70,000 without aid)
Kabila's rebel movement and political polarization/uncertainty over dialogue
Cholera-like diarrhoea outbreak in North Kivu and payment crisis for Ebola response staff
Miner protests in Kolwezi, 'Stop Ebola' day and shutdown in Beni, and tax-related reactions

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a spreading Ebola outbreak with a record caseload, fighting and health-system disruption in North Kivu, and an African Union warning against seizure of power by force amid a political and security crisis. Some positives, such as the National Assembly passing development financing, the school reopening in Inongo and the census going smoothly, do not offset these.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading, with more cases in North Kivu than Ituri
AU warns against seizure of power by force amid political crisis
Fighting in North Kivu leaves only 11 of 22 health zones working

summary.en: The DRC faces a severe Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread, renewed hostilities that have forced thousands to flee in the southeast, and a new rebel alliance. Local protests in Kolwezi are calming, but food prices are rising and political tensions are high.

en: Ebola outbreak rebounds, nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread
Thousands flee escalating hostilities in southeastern DRC
New rebel alliance and FDLR-related conflict coverage

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 DRC cases, ADF and CODECO massacres and hostage killings in the east, and a political rift between Tshisekedi and Kabila. Together these point to serious humanitarian and security strain, with no offsetting peace or recovery signal.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases, spreading to Nigeria and health workers infected
77 civilians killed by ADF in Mambasa; over 80,000 displaced
Two hostages killed after CODECO abduction in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak, with deaths near 4,700 and cases in an eighth province, partly offset by the start of a vaccine trial. Domestic politics also show strain, including arrests of political figures and a no-confidence motion.

en: Ebola outbreak nearing 4,700 deaths and spreading to eighth province
Start of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine trial in Bunia
Arrests of opposition figure and UDPS cadre; no-confidence motion against minister

summary.en: The period mixes a major Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain), with Uganda restricting transit and Ebola response workers striking over unpaid bonuses, against a positive step in the launch of a vaccine trial. Political and security stress also shows up in more than 100 detentions in Lubumbashi, protests in Kisangani, and no-confidence motions in Tshuapa and Kinshasa.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading cross-border; Uganda restricts DRC-linked travellers
Launch of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine clinical trial in Bunia
Over 100 people detained in Lubumbashi security operations

summary.en: The period is dominated by an expanding Ebola outbreak, including a nurse killed over Ebola rumours and new Ugandan travel restrictions, alongside a constitutional referendum dispute and security-force violence against protesters and Catholic worshippers. Some positives, such as Ebola recoveries and FARDC operations against ADF, do not offset the serious problems.

en: Nurse killed in Bafwasende over Ebola rumours; health workers attacked
Uganda imposes travel restrictions and 21-day quarantine on DRC travellers
Security forces reportedly fire on Catholic faithful; Kolwezi unrest with 58 arrests

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak with attacks on health workers, including a nurse killed, and deadly CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Political strain is also visible in a contested referendum law, a provincial governor's removal, and Kolwezi protests. Positive signals such as a vaccine trial, infrastructure launches and a youth peace festival do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases with attacks on health workers
CODECO attacks in Djugu killing more than a dozen people
Referendum law adoption and Senate opposition

summary.en: The period is dominated by an Ebola outbreak that passed 10,000 cases, with 1,424 deaths reported in North Kivu and a treatment centre overwhelmed, plus armed clashes in South Kivu and CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Modest positives, such as recoveries, a solar plant inauguration and a vaccine trial, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases; 1,424 deaths in North Kivu
Treatment centre in Beni overwhelmed; nurse killed by mob
FARDC–FRN clashes in Fizi and Walungu; CODECO attacks in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a record Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases), renewed fighting around Uvira and Walikale with new displacements, and drone strikes linked to the Kabila-aligned FRN. Some positives, such as no new Ebola cases at Mongbwalu, rebel surrenders in Fizi and calm returning to Lodja, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases, concentrated in Ituri
Fighting around Uvira and renewed displacement in Walikale
Kabila-aligned FRN rebels and drone strike allegations

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, 4,900 deaths reported) and renewed fighting in the east that is displacing civilians and disrupting relief. Partial positives include a vaccine trial, a fighter surrender in Fizi, and US sanctions on Rwanda that Kinshasa welcomed, but they do not offset the crisis.

en: Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,900 deaths
Renewed fighting in Ituri and Walikale displaces thousands of civilians
464 human rights violations documented in July by BCNUDH

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic in the east, with over 10,000 cases and a death toll near 5,000, alongside ongoing armed attacks, M23/FRN fighting and ADF activity. Positive news, such as exiting the FATF grey list, is outweighed by these serious humanitarian and security problems.

en: Ebola outbreak: over 2,300 new confirmed cases in three weeks
Eastern conflict: M23/FRN fighting near Uvira and renewed ADF presence
Removal from FATF grey list as a positive institutional signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic (reported death toll above 5,000), a cholera outbreak in Mbandaka, active fighting in Masisi, and worsening hunger. Political tensions are also high, with a detained opposition figure denied bail and the president targeting Kabila allies.

en: Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 in DR Congo
Cholera outbreak in Mbandaka: 14 deaths, 129 cases
Violent FARDC-FRN combat in Masisi

summary.en: An Ebola outbreak with over 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases is spreading with no approved vaccine, alongside displacement, unaided humanitarian needs and killings in the east. Political tension over the Tshisekedi family case and arrests of a lawyer add to the strain, with only minor positives such as an airline lease and a promotional claim of eastern stability.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases
Thousands of displaced people without humanitarian assistance in North Kivu
Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict and Ebola

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths, ongoing armed conflict in the east, and a projected hunger crisis affecting over 30 million people. Modest positives, such as the release of about 50 ADF ex-hostages and cautious hope around US sanctions, do not offset this humanitarian catastrophe.
summary.ja: 今期は、死者5,300人を超えると報告された大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行、東部での継続的な武力紛争、そして3,000万人以上に影響すると予測される飢餓危機が中心となっています。ADFの元人質約50人の解放や、米国の制裁措置に対する慎重な期待といった小さな前向きな動きは、この人道危機を相殺するものではありません。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 사망자 5,300명이 넘는 것으로 보고된 대규모 에볼라 발병, 동부 지역의 지속적인 무력 분쟁, 3,000만 명 이상에게 영향을 미칠 것으로 예상되는 기아 위기가 지배하고 있습니다. ADF 전 인질 약 50명의 석방과 미국 제재에 대한 신중한 기대와 같은 소폭의 긍정적 요소들은 이 인도적 재난을 상쇄하지 못합니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि 5,300 से अधिक मौतों वाले एक बड़े इबोला प्रकोप, पूर्वी क्षेत्र में जारी सशस्त्र संघर्ष और 3 करोड़ से अधिक लोगों को प्रभावित करने वाले अनुमानित भुखमरी संकट से प्रभावित है। ADF के लगभग 50 पूर्व बंधकों की रिहाई और अमेरिकी प्रतिबंधों को लेकर सतर्क आशा जैसे मामूली सकारात्मक पहलू इस मानवीय आपदा की भरपाई नहीं करते।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από μια μεγάλη επιδημία Έμπολα με αναφερόμενους πάνω από 5.300 θανάτους, τη συνεχιζόμενη ένοπλη σύγκρουση στην ανατολή και μια προβλεπόμενη κρίση πείνας που επηρεάζει πάνω από 30 εκατομμύρια ανθρώπους. Μέτριες θετικές εξελίξεις, όπως η απελευθέρωση περίπου 50 πρώην ομήρων της ADF και η επιφυλακτική ελπίδα σχετικά με τις κυρώσεις των ΗΠΑ, δεν αντισταθμίζουν αυτή την ανθρωπιστική καταστροφή.
summary.tr: Dönemin başlıca gündemini, 5.300'den fazla ölüm bildirilen geniş çaplı bir Ebola salgını, doğuda süregelen silahlı çatışmalar ve 30 milyondan fazla kişiyi etkilemesi öngörülen bir açlık krizi oluşturuyor. ADF'nin yaklaşık 50 eski rehinesinin serbest bırakılması ve ABD yaptırımlarına ilişkin temkinli umut gibi sınırlı olumlu gelişmeler, bu insani felaketi dengelemeye yetmiyor.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por un gran brote de ébola, con más de 5.300 muertes notificadas, el conflicto armado en curso en el este y una crisis de hambre proyectada que afectaría a más de 30 millones de personas. Avances modestos, como la liberación de unos 50 exrehenes de las ADF y la cautelosa esperanza en torno a las sanciones de EE. UU., no compensan esta catástrofe humanitaria.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par une vaste épidémie d'Ebola, avec plus de 5 300 décès signalés, par le conflit armé qui se poursuit dans l'est et par une crise alimentaire prévue touchant plus de 30 millions de personnes. Les avancées modestes, comme la libération d'environ 50 anciens otages des ADF et l'espoir prudent suscité par les sanctions américaines, ne compensent pas cette catastrophe humanitaire.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von einem großen Ebola-Ausbruch mit über 5.300 gemeldeten Todesfällen, dem andauernden bewaffneten Konflikt im Osten und einer prognostizierten Hungerkrise geprägt, von der mehr als 30 Millionen Menschen betroffen sein könnten. Bescheidene positive Entwicklungen, etwa die Freilassung von rund 50 ehemaligen ADF-Geiseln und die vorsichtige Hoffnung im Zusammenhang mit US-Sanktionen, können diese humanitäre Katastrophe nicht aufwiegen.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por um grande surto de ebola, com mais de 5.300 mortes relatadas, pelo conflito armado em curso no leste e por uma crise de fome projetada que afetará mais de 30 milhões de pessoas. Avanços modestos, como a libertação de cerca de 50 ex-reféns das ADF e a cautelosa esperança em torno das sanções dos EUA, não compensam essa catástrofe humanitária.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da un ampio focolaio di Ebola, con oltre 5,300 decessi segnalati, dal conflitto armato in corso nell'est e da una previsione di crisi alimentare che colpisce oltre 30 milioni di persone. Alcuni segnali positivi, come il rilascio di circa 50 ex ostaggi dell'ADF e la cauta speranza riguardo alle sanzioni statunitensi, non attenuano questa catastrofe umanitaria.
summary.ru: Период определяется масштабной вспышкой Эболы, с более чем 5,300 зарегистрированными смертельными случаями, продолжающимся вооружённым конфликтом на востоке и прогнозируемым продовольственным кризисом, затрагивающим более 30 миллионов человек. Умеренно позитивные события, такие как освобождение около 50 бывших заложников ADF и осторожная надежда в связи с санкциями США, не компенсируют эту гуманитарную катастрофу.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة تفشٍّ واسع النطاق لفيروس إيبولا أُفيد بتسجيل أكثر من 5,300 وفاة، وصراع مسلح مستمر في الشرق، وأزمة جوع متوقعة تؤثر على أكثر من 30 مليون شخص. ولا تقلل الإيجابيات المحدودة، مثل إطلاق سراح نحو 50 من الرهائن السابقين لدى ADF والأمل الحذر بشأن العقوبات الأمريكية، من هذه الكارثة الإنسانية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر شیوع گسترده ابولا با بیش از 5,300 مرگ گزارش‌شده، درگیری مسلحانه جاری در شرق، و بحران گرسنگی پیش‌بینی‌شده که بیش از 30 میلیون نفر را تحت تأثیر قرار می‌دهد، قرار دارد. نکات مثبت محدودی مانند آزادی حدود 50 گروگان سابق ADF و امید محتاطانه نسبت به تحریم‌های آمریکا، این فاجعه بشردوستانه را جبران نمی‌کند.
summary.zh: 该时期主要受以下因素影响：据报告死亡人数超过5,300人的大规模埃博拉疫情、东部持续的武装冲突，以及预计将影响3,000万以上人口的饥饿危机。约50名ADF前人质获释以及对美国制裁的谨慎期待等一些积极因素，并不能抵消这场人道主义灾难。

en: Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths
Projected hunger for over 30 million amid conflict and Ebola
Ongoing conflict with FRN/M23 and Rwanda tensions

Çatışma ve Ebola ortamında 30 milyondan fazla kişi için öngörülen açlık
FRN/M23 ile süregelen çatışma ve Ruanda ile gerginlikler

Hambre proyectada para más de 30 millones de personas en medio del conflicto y el ébola
Conflicto en curso con el FRN/M23 y tensiones con Ruanda

Faim prévue pour plus de 30 millions de personnes, dans un contexte de conflit et d'Ebola
Conflit en cours avec le FRN/M23 et tensions avec le Rwanda

Prognostizierter Hunger für mehr als 30 Millionen Menschen inmitten von Konflikt und Ebola
Anhaltender Konflikt mit der FRN/M23 und Spannungen mit Ruanda

summary.en: In Guinea over the last 24 hours there is a routine agenda: preparations for the Senate election, water and road infrastructure projects, a new state tobacco company, the start of the university term, and a corruption case. The Simandou iron ore project reaching a production rate of about 10 Mtpa is economically positive, while the fatal passenger accident at Séguéya is negative but local in scale. Since there is no clear crisis or major improvement, the score is near neutral, slightly positive.

en: Simandou iron ore production reaching a rate of about 10 Mtpa
Announcement of candidate bonds and campaign spending limits for the Senate elections
Announcement of water (600 million euros) and road infrastructure projects
Passenger accident at Séguéya resulting in 2 dead and 34 injured
Waiting time at the Port of Conakry falling to 15 days, with additional costs continuing

summary.en: The period mixes positive investment news (a $2bn UK Export Finance envelope and £330m in contracts) and a youth-participation initiative with routine judicial cases, a municipal wage-arrears strike threat and a magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake that the headlines show only as a government response plan. On balance this is an ordinary day with a slight positive lean.

en: UK Export Finance $2bn and £330m investment announcements
Magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake near Conakry, government prevention plan
Municipal wage arrears and threatened indefinite strike in Dixinn

summary.en: The period was mostly routine governance and economic news: judicial appointments, e-signature and public-finance reforms, and upbeat Simandou revenue and UK investment figures. The main negative item was a former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years, and GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Simandou revenue projections rising to $2.5 billion by 2040
UK investment ambition lifted above $3 billion
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: The period is mostly routine administration: a 4,500-post health recruitment, validation of a public finance reform plan, and Simandou diplomacy. The main negative item is the seven-year sentence of a former Constitutional Court president, alongside a security crackdown in Conakry, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years in prison
Conakry crackdown on crime and drug networks launched by prosecutor
Validation of 2026-2030 public finance reform strategy

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure approvals, a health recruitment drive, China partnership pledges and a strong run by the U18 team at the world school championship. Offsetting this are a jailing of a former Constitutional Court president and a union dispute, and GDELT tone (-0.33) is less negative than the world average.

en: Guinea U18 team advances at the world school championship
Labé–Tougué road and Kankan–Kissidougou works advance
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: A mostly routine day in Guinea: the revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and rising inflation amid an oil crisis, but a state bond issue was heavily oversubscribed and a road loan was ratified. Security operations and union wage demands are ordinary news, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Oversubscribed state bond raising 4,579 billion GNF
Revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and higher inflation
Road loan for Labé-Tougué highway ratified

summary.en: The period was routine and mildly positive, dominated by youth football results (a U20 qualification for the CAN, a U18 World Cup final loss, and a U15 win) and a Horoya CAF qualification. Fuel prices were held at 12,000 GNF and new administrative units were created, with no sign of a political or security crisis.

en: U20 team qualifies for CAN 2027 final
Fuel price maintained at 12,000 GNF
Timbo and Wanindara administrative upgrades announced

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Guinea signed the Accra Convention on trade and SME credit, and a 2026 growth forecast of 8.6% was reported alongside Simandou progress. Offsetting this, a former Constitutional Court president was sentenced to seven years, and a journalist died, which keeps the score only modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Signing of Accra Convention on trade and SME credit access
Reported 8.6% growth forecast for 2026 and Simandou push
Sentencing of former Constitutional Court president by CRIEF

summary.en: A largely routine day in Guinea: the state raised about 4,500 billion GNF on the local bank market and a $517 million bond, and new budget rules were validated. Negatives are minor, including contract teachers protesting exclusion from recruitment and complaints about the Kankan–Kissidougou road, and the GDELT tone (-0.10) is better than the world average.

en: State raised about 4,500 billion GNF on local banking market
$517 million state bond issuance mobilised
Public expenditure nomenclature and local accounting plan validated

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a successful 4,579 billion GNF bond issuance, Proparco financing for Soguipal, new ministerial and judicial appointments, and Simandou and China investment news. Negatives are limited to anger in Faranah over a student's death and job cuts at Bel Air Mining, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: State mobilised 4,579 billion GNF through its 2026 bond issue
Proparco's 5 million euro financing for Soguipal expansion
Anger in Faranah after a student's death, with hospital explanations

summary.en: Guinea's news over the period is mostly routine but leans positive, led by a government bond raise of 4,579 billion GNF (nearly double the target) and a $520 million local financing. Mining (Simandou), a UN visit and stadium homologation add to the stable picture, offset only by a military dismissals decree and a media-minister story.

en: Bond issue of 4,579 billion GNF, nearly double target
$520 million raised on local financial market
Simandou mining operations and Rio Tinto SimFer coverage

summary.en: Routine news dominated the period: a domestic bond issuance, a sports title, a hotel deal, and Simandou mining coverage, with GDELT tone (-0.10) well above the world average. Negatives were local (power shortages, administrative suspensions in Siguiri, student housing complaints), and no crisis or crackdown appears in the headlines.

en: Simandou mining coverage and a hotel development deal signed in Conakry

Administrative suspensions in Siguiri and power shortages affecting communities

en: Government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, exceeding initial target
Parliament adopted the revised 2026 budget law
About 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported blocked

summary.en: The period was mostly upbeat: the inauguration of the country's first gold refinery, a record bond issue, and new investment partnerships, alongside routine army anniversary events. Negatives were local and limited, including a water shortage protest in Kérouané and errors in a school digital system.

Record bond issue in Guinean francs and new Samsung investment partnership
Local water shortage protest and school digital system errors

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: the inauguration of a first gold refinery and urban-rehabilitation projects are positive, while the central bank's warnings on liquidity and cash shortages and the army deployment against illegal gold mining in Siguiri weigh against them. GDELT tone is above the world average, so the overall picture is slightly positive.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor: ilk altın rafinerisinin açılışı ve kentsel yenileme projeleri olumlu gelişmeler olarak öne çıkarken, merkez bankasının likidite ve nakit sıkıntısına ilişkin uyarıları ile Siguiri'de yasadışı altın madenciliğine karşı orduya başvurulması bu tabloyu olumsuz etkiliyor. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasının üzerinde olduğundan genel görünüm hafifçe olumlu.
summary.es: El periodo transcurre en gran medida con normalidad: la inauguración de la primera refinería de oro y los proyectos de rehabilitación urbana son positivos, mientras que las advertencias del banco central sobre la liquidez y la escasez de efectivo, así como el despliegue del ejército contra la minería ilegal de oro en Siguiri, pesan en sentido contrario. El tono de GDELT está por encima de la media mundial, por lo que el panorama general es ligeramente positivo.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : l'inauguration d'une première raffinerie d'or et les projets de réhabilitation urbaine sont positifs, tandis que les mises en garde de la banque centrale sur la liquidité et les pénuries de liquidités, ainsi que le déploiement de l'armée contre l'orpaillage illégal à Siguiri, pèsent en sens contraire. Le ton GDELT est supérieur à la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que le tableau d'ensemble est légèrement positif.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig: Die Eröffnung der ersten Goldraffinerie und Projekte zur städtischen Sanierung wirken positiv, während die Warnungen der Zentralbank vor Liquiditäts- und Bargeldengpässen sowie der Armeeeinsatz gegen illegalen Goldbergbau in Siguiri dagegen sprechen. Der GDELT-Tonwert liegt über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt, sodass das Gesamtbild leicht positiv ausfällt.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, de rotina: a inauguração de uma primeira refinaria de ouro e os projetos de reabilitação urbana são positivos, enquanto os alertas do banco central sobre liquidez e escassez de numerário, bem como a mobilização do exército contra a mineração ilegal de ouro em Siguiri, pesam em sentido contrário. O tom do GDELT está acima da média mundial, pelo que o quadro geral é ligeiramente positivo.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: l'inaugurazione di una prima raffineria d'oro e i progetti di riqualificazione urbana sono positivi, mentre gli avvertimenti della banca centrale su liquidità e carenza di contante e il dispiegamento dell'esercito contro l'estrazione illegale d'oro a Siguiri pesano in senso contrario. Il tono GDELT è superiore alla media mondiale, quindi il quadro complessivo è leggermente positivo.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: открытие первого золотоперерабатывающего завода и проекты городского обновления имеют положительный характер, тогда как предупреждения центрального банка о ликвидности и нехватке наличных, а также развертывание армии против незаконной добычи золота в Сигири оказывают обратное влияние. Тон GDELT выше среднемирового, поэтому общая картина слегка позитивная.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: افتتاح أول مصفاة للذهب ومشاريع إعادة تأهيل المدن إيجابيان، في حين تثقل تحذيرات البنك المركزي بشأن السيولة ونقص النقد، وانتشار الجيش ضد التعدين غير المشروع للذهب في سيغيري، الصورة في الاتجاه المعاكس. ونبرة GDELT أعلى من المتوسط العالمي، لذا فالصورة العامة إيجابية بشكل طفيف.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر عادی است: افتتاح نخستین پالایشگاه طلا و طرح‌های بازسازی شهری مثبت‌اند، در حالی که هشدارهای بانک مرکزی درباره نقدینگی و کمبود پول نقد، و استقرار ارتش علیه استخراج غیرقانونی طلا در سیگیری، در خلاف جهت عمل می‌کنند. لحن GDELT بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین تصویر کلی اندکی مثبت است.
summary.zh: 本时段大体属于例行事务：首座黄金精炼厂投产及城市改造项目属于积极因素，而央行关于流动性和现金短缺的警告，以及在锡吉里针对非法金矿开采部署军队，则构成负面因素。GDELT语气高于全球平均水平，因此总体情况略为正面。
summary.ja: 今期の動向はおおむね定例的なものです。最初の金精錬所の開所や都市再生事業は前向きな材料である一方、中央銀行による流動性と現金不足への警告、およびシギリ地域の違法金採掘に対する軍の展開が、これらを相殺する方向に作用しています。GDELTのトーンは世界平均を上回っており、全体としてはわずかに前向きな状況です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간의 동향은 대체로 일상적입니다. 첫 금 제련소의 개소와 도시 재생 사업은 긍정적인 요소인 반면, 중앙은행의 유동성 및 현금 부족 경고와 시기리(Siguiri)의 불법 금광 채굴에 대한 군 투입은 이를 상쇄하는 방향으로 작용하고 있습니다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 높아 전반적인 상황은 다소 긍정적입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि का घटनाक्रम अधिकतर नियमित है: पहली सोने की रिफाइनरी का उद्घाटन और शहरी पुनर्वास परियोजनाएँ सकारात्मक हैं, जबकि तरलता और नकदी की कमी पर केंद्रीय बैंक की चेतावनियाँ तथा सिगिरी में अवैध सोना खनन के विरुद्ध सेना की तैनाती इनके विपरीत प्रभाव डालती हैं। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से ऊपर है, इसलिए समग्र तस्वीर थोड़ी सकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: τα εγκαίνια του πρώτου διυλιστηρίου χρυσού και τα προγράμματα αστικής αναβάθμισης είναι θετικά, ενώ οι προειδοποιήσεις της κεντρικής τράπεζας για ρευστότητα και έλλειψη μετρητών, καθώς και η ανάπτυξη του στρατού κατά της παράνομης εξόρυξης χρυσού στο Σιγκιρί, λειτουργούν αντισταθμιστικά. Ο τόνος του GDELT βρίσκεται πάνω από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, οπότε η συνολική εικόνα είναι ελαφρώς θετική.

summary.tr: Bulgaristan, ilk kez seçilmiş bir kadın cumhurbaşkanı çıkaran barışçıl bir cumhurbaşkanlığı ikinci turu yaptı; bu, rutin bir demokratik kilometre taşı. Bunun karşısında, kıyı açıklarında bir gemiyi batıran bir insansız hava aracı saldırısı, kırmızı kodlu sel ve hava uyarıları ile gaz fiyatlarındaki artışa yönelik kamuoyu öfkesi yer alıyor.
summary.es: Bulgaria celebró una segunda vuelta presidencial pacífica que dio como resultado su primera presidenta elegida, un hito democrático rutinario. Contrastan con ello un ataque con drones que hundió un barco frente a la costa, avisos de inundaciones y alerta meteorológica de código rojo, y la indignación pública por las subidas del precio del gas.
summary.fr: La Bulgarie a organisé un second tour présidentiel pacifique qui a porté à la présidence sa première femme élue, une étape démocratique de routine. Ce bilan est contrebalancé par une frappe de drone qui a coulé un navire au large des côtes, des alertes inondation et un code rouge météorologique, ainsi que par la colère du public face à la hausse des prix du gaz.
summary.de: Bulgarien hat eine friedliche Stichwahl zum Präsidenten abgehalten, aus der seine erste gewählte Präsidentin hervorging, ein routinemäßiger demokratischer Meilenstein. Dem gegenüber stehen ein Drohnenangriff, bei dem ein Schiff vor der Küste versenkt wurde, Hochwasser- und Unwetterwarnungen mit roter Warnstufe sowie öffentlicher Ärger über steigende Gaspreise.
summary.pt: A Bulgária realizou um segundo turno presidencial pacífico que resultou na sua primeira presidente eleita, um marco democrático de rotina. Contrabalançando isso, um ataque de drone afundou um navio na costa, há alertas de cheias e código vermelho meteorológico, e a indignação pública com a subida dos preços do gás.
summary.it: La Bulgaria ha tenuto un ballottaggio presidenziale pacifico che ha portato alla prima presidente donna eletta, un traguardo democratico di routine. Questo è controbilanciato da un attacco con drone che ha affondato una nave al largo della costa, da avvisi di alluvione e di codice rosso per il maltempo e dalla rabbia pubblica per l'aumento dei prezzi del gas.
summary.ru: В Болгарии прошёл мирный второй тур президентских выборов, в результате которого впервые была избрана женщина-президент — рутинная веха демократического развития. Это уравновешивается ударом беспилотника, потопившим судно у побережья, предупреждениями о наводнениях и погодной опасности с красным кодом, а также общественным возмущением из-за роста цен на газ.
summary.ar: أجرت بلغاريا جولة الإعادة من الانتخابات الرئاسية بسلام، أسفرت عن انتخاب أول رئيسة للبلاد، وهو إنجاز ديمقراطي اعتيادي. ويقابل ذلك هجوم بطائرة مسيّرة أغرق سفينة قبالة الساحل، وتحذيرات من الفيضانات وإنذارات طقس بالرمز الأحمر، وغضب شعبي إزاء ارتفاع أسعار الغاز.
summary.fa: بلغارستان دور دوم انتخابات ریاست جمهوری را با آرامش برگزار کرد که به انتخاب نخستین رئیس‌جمهور زن این کشور انجامید؛ دستاوردی معمول در مسیر دموکراسی. در مقابل، حمله پهپادی یک کشتی را در نزدیکی سواحل غرق کرد، هشدارهای سیل و هواشناسی با کد قرمز صادر شد و خشم عمومی از افزایش قیمت گاز بالا گرفته است.
summary.zh: 保加利亚总统选举第二轮投票平稳进行，选出了该国首位民选女总统，这是一项常规的民主里程碑。与此同时，无人机袭击在海岸附近击沉一艘船只，当局发布了洪水预警和红色级别天气警报，民众也因天然气价格上涨而表达愤怒。
summary.ja: ブルガリアでは大統領決選投票が平和裏に行われ、同国初の女性大統領が選出された。これは民主主義における通例の節目である。一方、沿岸沖ではドローン攻撃により船舶が沈没し、洪水と赤色気象警報が出されたほか、ガス価格の上昇に対して国民の怒りが高まっている。
summary.ko: 불가리아에서는 평화로운 분위기 속에 대통령 결선투표가 치러져 선출된 첫 여성 대통령이 탄생했다. 이는 일상적인 민주주의의 이정표이다. 한편 연안 해상에서 드론 공격으로 선박이 침몰했고, 홍수 및 적색 기상 경보가 발령되었으며, 가스 요금 인상에 대한 시민들의 분노도 이어지고 있다.
summary.hi: बुल्गारिया में एक शांतिपूर्ण राष्ट्रपति रनऑफ़ चुनाव हुआ, जिसमें देश की पहली निर्वाचित महिला राष्ट्रपति चुनी गईं, जो लोकतंत्र में एक नियमित उपलब्धि है। इसके विपरीत, तट के पास एक ड्रोन हमले में एक जहाज़ डूब गया, बाढ़ और लाल-कोड मौसम चेतावनियाँ जारी हुईं, और गैस की कीमतों में वृद्धि को लेकर जनता में आक्रोश है।
summary.el: Η Βουλγαρία πραγματοποίησε ειρηνικό δεύτερο γύρο προεδρικών εκλογών, που ανέδειξε την πρώτη εκλεγμένη γυναίκα πρόεδρό της, ένα συνηθισμένο ορόσημο της δημοκρατίας. Αντίβαρο αποτελούν η επίθεση με drone που βύθισε πλοίο ανοιχτά της ακτής, οι προειδοποιήσεις για πλημμύρες και κόκκινο κωδικό καιρού, καθώς και η δημόσια οργή για την αύξηση των τιμών του φυσικού αερίου.

summary.it: Dominano le notizie di routine: il lancio di un marchamo digitale, una decisione della Contraloría che conferma l'aggiudicazione della gara per il 5G dell'ICE e la promozione turistica, con un tono positivo secondo GDELT. A controbilanciare ci sono i sindacati, che denunciano pressioni del governo, una controversia sulla condotta di un giudice e le polemiche sull'acquisto di un'ambulanza e sulle finanze della Croce Rossa, per cui il punteggio è solo leggermente superiore a quello di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Преобладают рутинные новости: запуск цифрового marchamo, решение Contraloría, подтверждающее результаты тендера ICE на 5G, и продвижение туризма, при позитивной тональности по данным GDELT. Этому противостоят заявления профсоюзов о давлении со стороны правительства, спор о поведении судьи и споры вокруг закупки машины скорой помощи и финансов Красного Креста, поэтому показатель лишь немного выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: تهيمن الأخبار الروتينية: إطلاق ملصق المركبات الرقمي marchamo، وقرار من هيئة Contraloría يؤيد منح مناقصة شبكة الجيل الخامس لمعهد الكهرباء ICE، والترويج للسياحة، مع نبرة إيجابية وفق GDELT. ويقابل ذلك ادعاءات النقابات بوجود ضغوط حكومية، وخلاف حول سلوك أحد القضاة، والجدل حول شراء سيارة إسعاف وأوضاع مالية للصليب الأحمر، لذلك لا يتجاوز المؤشر بقليل يوماً عادياً.
summary.fa: اخبار روتین غالب است: راه‌اندازی مارچامو دیجیتال، رأی Contraloría مبنی بر تأیید مناقصه ۵G مؤسسه ICE و ترویج گردشگری، با لحن مثبت GDELT. در مقابل، اتحادیه‌ها از فشار دولت شکایت دارند، اختلافی بر سر رفتار یک قاضی وجود دارد و جنجال‌هایی بر سر خرید یک آمبولانس و امور مالی صلیب سرخ مطرح است، به همین دلیل امتیاز تنها کمی بالاتر از یک روز عادی است.
summary.zh: 以常规新闻为主：数字版marchamo上线、审计署（Contraloría）裁定维持ICE 5G招标结果，以及旅游推广，GDELT语气偏正面。另一方面，工会指称政府施压，一名法官的行为引发争议，救护车采购和红十字会财务也受到质疑，因此得分仅略高于普通的一天。
summary.ja: 日常的なニュースが中心で、デジタル自動車税票（マルチャミント）の導入、ICEの5G入札を承認した会計検査院（Contraloría）の判断、観光促進活動が報じられ、GDELTのトーンはポジティブである。一方で、労働組合による政府の圧力疑惑、判事の行動をめぐる対立、救急車購入と赤十字の財務をめぐる論争がこれを相殺しており、スコアは通常の一日をわずかに上回る程度にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 일상적인 뉴스가 대부분을 차지한다. 디지털 자동차세 표지(마르차미엔토) 도입, ICE 5G 입찰을 인정한 감사원(Contraloría)의 판단, 관광 홍보 활동이 보도되었으며 GDELT 논조는 긍정적이다. 반면 노조의 정부 압력 주장, 판사의 행동을 둘러싼 분쟁, 구급차 구매와 적십자 재정을 둘러싼 논란이 이를 상쇄하여, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 약간 높은 수준에 머문다.
summary.hi: सामान्य समाचार प्रमुख हैं: डिजिटल मार्चामिन्हो (वाहन कर पत्र) का शुभारंभ, ICE 5G निविदा को मंजूरी देने वाला कॉन्ट्रालोरिया (लेखा परीक्षा निकाय) का निर्णय, और पर्यटन संवर्धन। GDELT का स्वर सकारात्मक है। इसके विपरीत, श्रमिक संघों द्वारा सरकारी दबाव के आरोप, एक न्यायाधीश के आचरण पर विवाद, तथा एंबुलेंस खरीद और रेड क्रॉस के वित्त पर विवाद हैं, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा ही ऊपर है।
summary.el: Κυριαρχούν οι συνήθεις ειδήσεις: η έναρξη της ψηφιακής μαρκίας οχημάτων (marchamo), η απόφαση της Contraloría που εγκρίνει τον διαγωνισμό 5G του ICE και η προώθηση του τουρισμού, με θετικό τόνο στο GDELT. Αντισταθμίζονται από καταγγελίες συνδικάτων για πιέσεις της κυβέρνησης, διαμάχη για τη συμπεριφορά ενός δικαστή και αμφιλεγόμενες υποθέσεις σχετικά με την αγορά ασθενοφόρου και τα οικονομικά του Ερυθρού Σταυρού, με αποτέλεσμα η βαθμολογία να βρίσκεται μόνο ελαφρώς πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.tr: Rutin haberler öne çıkıyor: dijital marchamo'nun başlatılması, Contraloría'nın ICE 5G ihalesini onaylayan kararı ve turizm tanıtımı; GDELT tonu olumlu. Buna karşın sendikaların hükümet baskısı iddiaları, bir yargıcın davranışına ilişkin anlaşmazlık ve bir ambulans alımı ile Kızılhaç'ın mali durumu üzerindeki tartışmalar bu tabloyu dengeliyor; bu nedenle puan sıradan bir günün yalnızca biraz üzerinde kalıyor.
summary.es: Predominan las noticias rutinarias: el lanzamiento de un marchamo digital, una resolución de la Contraloría que avala la adjudicación de la licitación 5G del ICE y la promoción turística, con un tono positivo según GDELT. Por otro lado, los sindicatos denuncian presiones del gobierno, hay una disputa por la conducta de un juez y polémica por la compra de una ambulancia y las finanzas de la Cruz Roja, por lo que la puntuación apenas supera la de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: Les nouvelles de routine dominent : le lancement d'un marchamo numérique, une décision de la Contraloría confirmant l'attribution de l'appel d'offres 5G de l'ICE, et la promotion touristique, avec un ton positif selon GDELT. En contrepartie, les syndicats dénoncent des pressions du gouvernement, un différend porte sur la conduite d'un juge, et une polémique entoure l'achat d'une ambulance et les finances de la Croix-Rouge, si bien que le score ne dépasse que légèrement celui d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Routinemeldungen dominieren: die Einführung einer digitalen Marchamo, eine Entscheidung der Contraloría, die die Vergabe der 5G-Ausschreibung des ICE bestätigt, und Tourismusförderung, bei positivem GDELT-Ton. Dem stehen Vorwürfe der Gewerkschaften über Druck der Regierung, ein Streit über das Verhalten eines Richters sowie Kontroversen um einen Krankenwagenkauf und die Finanzen des Roten Kreuzes gegenüber, sodass der Wert nur leicht über dem eines gewöhnlichen Tages liegt.
summary.pt: Predominam notícias de rotina: o lançamento de um marchamo digital, uma decisão da Contraloría que mantém a adjudicação da licitação 5G do ICE e a promoção turística, com tom positivo segundo o GDELT. Em contrapartida, os sindicatos denunciam pressões do governo, há uma disputa sobre a conduta de um juiz e polêmica em torno da compra de uma ambulância e das finanças da Cruz Vermelha, pelo que a pontuação fica apenas ligeiramente acima de um dia comum.

Unions allege government pressure; institutional tensions persist

summary.en: Forest fires in Peru have caused 12 deaths and affected more than 800 people. El Niño risk, rains in Piura and a rising teen homicide rate are also in the news. On the other hand, there are routine developments such as an increase in banana exports, a tuberculosis vaccine project and local elections, but the positive news does not offset the negative. A day somewhat below average: serious, but not at the level of a widespread crisis.

en: Forest fires leave 12 dead and more than 800 affected
El Niño warnings and heavy rains in Piura
Decade-high teen homicides in Lima
25 Peruvians dead and 187 missing in the Russian army
Banana exports up 24.6% and a tuberculosis vaccine study

summary.en: Peru's period is dominated by El Niño-related flooding and wind alerts in the north and coast, with forecasts warning that worse rains are still to come, plus an electoral recount dispute in Piura. Positive items, including the Peru-Ecuador cooperation declaration and the Andean Community presidency, do not offset the disaster risk, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: El Niño floods in Piura and Tumbes, with school and market closures
Senamhi warns the heaviest rains are still to come
JNE orders vote recount in Piura over damaged records

summary.en: Peru faces an El Niño threat, with flooding in Piura, red rain alerts for several regions, and warnings of a 'Mega Niño', alongside a more negative-than-average news tone. Some positives appear, including a Citi view that Peru may respond best to El Niño in Latin America and a healthcare investment milestone, but the flood and climate risks dominate, pulling the score below an ordinary day.

en: Piura flooding and street collapse, with unspent flood-fund criticism
Senamhi red and orange rain alerts and 'Mega Niño' forecasts
Citi sees Peru's El Niño economic response as strongest in Latin America

summary.en: Peru faces a strong El Niño with flooding in Piura and Tumbes, port closures from heavy swells, and 12 fire deaths, alongside ongoing extortion and armed attacks. Government responses such as a supplementary budget credit for El Niño and emergency evacuation guidance partly offset the strain, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Strong El Niño causing flooding in Piura and northern coast
Fires linked to El Niño leave 12 dead
75 ports closed due to anomalous swells

summary.en: Peru's period is mostly routine: preparations for the Pope's visit, a solar investment, and relief measures for El Niño and wildfire victims. Negatives include El Niño damage, forest fires, illegal mining, a police shootout and a decree-powers grant, but no crisis of mass violence or institutional breakdown appears.

en: Government announces S/2,500M in bonuses for El Niño-affected families
El Niño rains and wildfires damaging crops and communities
Fujimori gets 90 days of decree powers to legislate

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and institutional news, including the Lote 192 oil deal, the return of Air Canada and papal visit preparations, with serious stress from extortion and kidnapping, drought, forest fires and El Niño underspending. Tone matches the world average, so the net picture is an ordinary-to-slightly-strained day.

en: Lote 192 deal: Petroloreto takes 75% and operates for 27 years
Surge in kidnapping and extortion reported by foreign media
Protests in Lima over insecurity and forest fires

summary.en: Peru's period looks broadly routine: regional election results and runoffs, preparations for the Pope's visit, and a private investment deal for Petroperú's Lot 192. Weighing against this are El Niño rains, a forest fire in Apurímac, falling cacao exports and a reported tourism decline.

en: Petroperú ceding Lot 192 to private firm with $230M investment
El Niño rains and cacao export decline
Forest fire in Apurímac needing urgent aerial aid

summary.en: The period mixes a major positive development, the confirmed Papal visit that is broadly welcomed, with weather-related disruption, including a Senamhi red alert for extreme rain across 11 departments and flooding in Tumbes. Ongoing security measures, the Petroperú restructuring and municipal election disputes add routine strain, and the news tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Confirmed Papal visit to Peru welcomed across domestic media
Senamhi red alert for extreme rain in 11 departments
Flooding and class suspensions in Tumbes and Piura

summary.en: Peru faces active flood emergencies: red-alert rains in Tumbes and Piura, a river overflow in Cusco that trapped people, and medicine shortages in the health system. Positive signals include flood-prevention expropriations, the upcoming papal visit, and steady corporate and mining news, so the overall picture is a serious but localized disaster period.

en: Red-alert rains and river overflows in Tumbes, Piura and Cusco
Kimbiri flood sweeping homes and trapping people

summary.en: The period is dominated by El Niño rain and heat records, flood alerts and local complaints about inadequate prevention, which weigh on the score. Partly offsetting this are preparations for the papal visit, record remittances and infrastructure investment interest, while a setback for justice in the forced sterilizations case adds to the negatives.

en: Record rainfall and flood alerts linked to El Niño across northern and coastal regions
Residents report inadequate prevention works ahead of El Niño

summary.en: Peru's period mixes routine news with forward-looking positives, including preparations for Pope Leo XIV's visit and an MEF forecast of export growth. Weather risks from El Niño, heavy rain in Piura, a heat wave, a large power outage and a dengue warning, plus a more negative-than-average news tone, offset those gains, so the day reads as roughly ordinary.

en: Papal visit preparations and planned events across the country
El Niño rain warnings for Piura and Tumbes
MEF forecast that Peru's exports will surpass Chile's

summary.en: Peru's period mixes ordinary politics with a regional flood isolating communities in Piura and Huancabamba and growing El Niño risk to growth. Positive items include an upgraded China trade deal from November 1, a pension expansion vote, and the routine proclamation of regional election results, so the balance is near a typical day.

en: River flooding isolates Huancabamba localities and blocks highway access

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: preparations for the papal visit, tourism records, and an upgraded China-Peru free trade protocol entering into force. These are offset by a significant El Niño warning, coastal swells, power cuts, and ongoing violence, but no acute crisis is reported.

summary.en: Peru faces a serious period driven by intense rains and a feared Super El Niño, with red alerts, blackouts across five northern regions, and a Senate grant of emergency powers. Inflation topping 5% and an estimated 3,200 heat-related deaths add strain, partly offset by a large mining investment and a China trade upgrade.

en: Super El Niño threat and red alert for intense rains
Senate grants emergency powers; blackouts in five northern regions
Inflation tops 5% for first time since 2023

summary.en: Heavy rains and flooding in Tumbes and Piura, red alerts across Lima and 16 regions, rising child dengue deaths and a prison riot with three dead weigh on the period. Government emergency responses, the Pope's upcoming visit and some resource and investment news partly offset this.
summary.it: Piogge intense e inondazioni a Tumbes e Piura, allerta rossa in tutta Lima e in 16 regioni, aumento dei decessi infantili per dengue e una rivolta in carcere con tre morti pesano sul periodo. Le risposte di emergenza del governo, la prossima visita del Papa e alcune notizie su risorse e investimenti attenuano in parte questo quadro.
summary.ru: Сильные дожди и наводнения в Тумбесе и Пьюре, красные предупреждения в Лиме и 16 регионах, рост детских смертей от денге и бунт в тюрьме с тремя погибшими определяют ситуацию за этот период. Частично смягчают картину экстренные меры правительства, предстоящий визит Папы Римского и новости о ресурсах и инвестициях.
summary.ar: تُثقل الأمطار الغزيرة والفيضانات في توexecutive تومبيس وبيورا، وإنذارات حمراء في ليما و16 منطقة، وارتفاع وفيات الأطفال بحمى الضنك، وشغب في السجن أسفر عن ثلاثة قتلى، على هذه الفترة. وتخفف جزئياً من هذه الصورة إجراءات الطوارئ الحكومية، والزيارة المرتقبة لبابا الفاتيكان، وبعض الأخبار المتعلقة بالموارد والاستثمار.
summary.fa: بارش‌های شدید و سیل در تومبس و پیورا، هشدارهای قرمز در لیما و ۱۶ منطقه، افزایش مرگ کودکان بر اثر تب دنگ و شورش در زندان با سه کشته، این دوره را تحت تأثیر قرار داده است. واکنش‌های اضطراری دولت، سفر آتی پاپ و برخی اخبار مربوط به منابع و سرمایه‌گذاری تا حدی این وضعیت را تعدیل می‌کنند.
summary.zh: 图姆斯和皮乌拉的暴雨与洪水、利马及16个大区的红色预警、儿童登革热死亡人数上升以及一起造成三人死亡的监狱暴乱，使这一时期的局势承压。政府的紧急应对措施、教宗即将到访以及部分资源和投资消息在一定程度上缓解了这一局面。
summary.ja: トゥンベスとピウラでの豪雨と洪水、リマと16地域に出された赤色警報、増加する小児のデング熱死者、3人が死亡した刑務所暴動が、この期間の重荷となっている。政府の緊急対応、ローマ教皇の訪問予定、資源や投資に関するニュースが、これを一部相殺している。
summary.ko: 퉁베스와 피우라의 폭우 및 홍수, 리마와 16개 지역에 발령된 적색경보, 늘어나는 어린이 뎅기열 사망자, 3명이 사망한 교도소 폭동이 이 기간을 무겁게 짓누르고 있다. 정부의 긴급 대응, 교황의 방문 예정, 일부 자원 및 투자 관련 소식이 이를 부분적으로 상쇄하고 있다.
summary.hi: टुम्बेस और पियूरा में भारी बारिश और बाढ़, लीमा और 16 क्षेत्रों में रेड अलर्ट, बच्चों में डेंगू से बढ़ती मौतें और तीन लोगों की मौत वाला जेल दंगा इस अवधि पर भारी पड़ रहे हैं। सरकारी आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रियाएँ, पोप की आगामी यात्रा और कुछ संसाधन व निवेश से जुड़ी खबरें इसे आंशिक रूप से संतुलित करती हैं।
summary.el: Οι έντονες βροχοπτώσεις και οι πλημμύρες στο Tumbes και το Piura, οι κόκκινοι συναγερμοί σε όλη τη Λίμα και σε 16 περιφέρειες, ο αυξανόμενος αριθμός θανάτων παιδιών από δengue και η εξέγερση σε φυλακή με τρεις νεκρούς βαραίνουν την περίοδο. Οι κυβερνητικές έκτακτες αντιδράσεις, η επερχόμενη επίσκεψη του Πάπα και ορισμένα νέα για πόρους και επενδύσεις εξισορροπούν εν μέρει την κατάσταση.
summary.tr: Tumbes ve Piura'da şiddetli yağışlar ve sel, Lima ile 16 bölgede kırmızı alarm, artan çocuk dengue ölümleri ve üç kişinin öldüğü bir cezaevi isyanı bu dönemi olumsuz etkiliyor. Hükümetin acil müdahaleleri, Papa'nın yaklaşan ziyareti ve bazı kaynak ve yatırım haberleri ise bunu kısmen dengeliyor.
summary.es: Las lluvias intensas e inundaciones en Tumbes y Piura, las alertas rojas en Lima y otras 16 regiones, el aumento de muertes infantiles por dengue y un motín penitenciario con tres muertos pesan sobre el periodo. Las respuestas de emergencia del Gobierno, la próxima visita del Papa y algunas noticias sobre recursos e inversiones compensan en parte esta situación.
summary.fr: De fortes pluies et des inondations à Tumbes et Piura, des alertes rouges à Lima et dans 16 régions, la hausse des décès d'enfants dus à la dengue et une émeute dans une prison ayant fait trois morts pèsent sur la période. Les interventions d'urgence du gouvernement, la prochaine visite du pape et certaines annonces concernant les ressources et les investissements compensent en partie ces éléments.
summary.de: Starke Regenfälle und Überschwemmungen in Tumbes und Piura, Alarmstufe Rot in Lima und 16 weiteren Regionen, steigende Dengue-Todesfälle bei Kindern sowie ein Gefängnisaufstand mit drei Toten belasten den Zeitraum. Notfallmaßnahmen der Regierung, der bevorstehende Besuch des Papstes sowie einige Nachrichten zu Ressourcen und Investitionen wirken dem teilweise entgegen.
summary.pt: Chuvas intensas e inundações em Tumbes e Piura, alertas vermelhos em Lima e em outras 16 regiões, o aumento das mortes de crianças por dengue e uma rebelião em presídio com três mortos pesam sobre o período. As respostas de emergência do governo, a próxima visita do Papa e algumas notícias sobre recursos e investimentos compensam parcialmente esse quadro.

summary.ja: 期間は概ね平常通りで、プーリア州での大雨警報、雪と寒さに関する警報、そしてボスニアでの軍用ヘリコプター墜落事故で死亡した軍人4名への追悼が報じられた。マイナス要因としては Ex Ilva の入札撤回、ストライキと混乱に関する報道、ステランティスの半導体不足があるが、FTSE MIB はほぼ横ばいで、GDELTのトーン（-0.24）は世界平均よりも穏やかである。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적이며, 풀리아 지역의 폭우 경보, 눈과 추위 경보, 그리고 보스니아에서 군용 헬리콥터 추락 사고로 숨진 군인 4명에 대한 애도가 있었다. 부정적 요인으로는 Ex Ilva 입찰 철회, 파업 및 소요 관련 보도, 스텔란티스의 반도체 부족이 있으나, FTSE MIB는 대체로 보합세이며 GDELT 어조(-0.24)는 세계 평균보다 온건하다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही, जिसमें पुग्लिया में भारी बारिश की चेतावनी, बर्फ़बारी और ठंड की चेतावनी, और बोस्निया में एक सैन्य हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटना में मारे गए चार सैन्यकर्मियों के लिए शोक शामिल है। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में Ex Ilva निविदा की वापसी, हड़ताल और अशांति से जुड़ी कवरेज, और Stellantis की चिप की कमी शामिल हैं, लेकिन FTSE MIB लगभग स्थिर है और GDELT टोन (-0.24) विश्व औसत से हल्का है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη, με προειδοποιήσεις για έντονες βροχοπτώσεις στην Απούλια, προειδοποίηση για χιόνι και κρύο, και πένθος για τέσσερα στρατιωτικά στελέχη που σκοτώθηκαν σε πτώση ελικοπτέρου στη Βοσνία. Τα αρνητικά περιλαμβάνουν την απόσυρση του διαγωνισμού για το Ex Ilva, καλύψεις για απεργίες και αναταραχές, και έλλειψη chips για τη Stellantis, ωστόσο ο FTSE MIB είναι περίπου σταθερός και ο τόνος του GDELT (-0.24) είναι ηπιότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine, con allerte per forti piogge in Puglia, un avviso per neve e freddo e il lutto per quattro militari morti nello schianto di un elicottero in Bosnia. Tra gli elementi negativi figurano il ritiro della gara per l'Ex Ilva, la copertura di scioperi e disordini e una carenza di chip per Stellantis, ma il FTSE MIB è sostanzialmente piatto e il tono di GDELT (-0,24) è più mite della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период в основном обычный: предупреждения о сильных дождях в Апулии, предупреждение о снеге и холоде и траур по четырём военнослужащим, погибшим при крушении вертолёта в Боснии. К негативным факторам относятся отзыв тендера на Ex Ilva, освещение забастовок и беспорядков и нехватка чипов для Stellantis, однако индекс FTSE MIB примерно неизменен, а тональность GDELT (-0,24) мягче среднемирового уровня.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها، مع تنبيهات بأمطار غزيرة في بوليا، وتحذير من الثلوج والبرد، وحداد على أربعة عسكريين قضوا في تحطم مروحية في البوسنة. ومن الجوانب السلبية سحب عطاء Ex Ilva، وتغطية الإضرابات والاضطرابات، ونقص الرقائق الإلكترونية لدى شركة Stellantis، لكن مؤشر FTSE MIB ظل مستقرًا تقريبًا، ونبرة GDELT (-0.24) أخف من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر عادی است؛ با هشدارهای بارش شدید در پولیا، هشدار برف و سرما و سوگواری برای چهار نظامی که در سقوط هلیکوپتر در بوسنی جان باختند. از جنبه‌های منفی می‌توان به لغو مناقصه Ex Ilva، پوشش اعتصابات و ناآرامی‌ها و کمبود تراشه برای استلانتیس اشاره کرد، اما شاخص FTSE MIB تقریباً ثابت است و لحن GDELT (۰.۲۴-) ملایم‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 本时段总体属于常规新闻，包括普利亚大暴雨预警、降雪和寒冷预警，以及为在波斯尼亚直升机坠毁事故中丧生的四名军人举行的哀悼活动。负面因素包括Ex Ilva招标被撤回、罢工和动荡的相关报道，以及Stellantis面临的芯片短缺，但富时意大利MIB指数大致持平，GDELT语气值（-0.24）温和于全球平均水平。
